original_observed_defect: Public schema had unclassified/open object surfaces outside explicit extension containers.
repair_05_change: Schema surface audit classifies every object as closed canonical, typed dynamic map, or explicit ExtensionMap; generic Record no longer exposes an open spec object.

original_observed_defect: Authority-changing extension names such as apply_allowed and release_allowed were not semantically refused.
repair_05_change: Validation now normalizes extension keys with NFKC/camel/separator tokenization and emits extension.authority_change for denied semantics.

original_observed_defect: Guard evidence was not proven through a real dispatcher with injected executor non-execution.
repair_05_change: GuardRequest/dispatch_guarded_request now reaches family guards, refuses before executor invocation, and records state digests and typed reasons.

original_observed_defect: operation-guard-conformance.json could be assembled from static successful dictionaries.
repair_05_change: Guard report is generated from dispatcher decisions, includes nonce-capable request IDs, reconciled counts, and a recomputable report digest.
